The change that made the value take effect is commit `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae` (PR #1920, "Pass locationsPerRequest to the login location picker and drop numberToShow"). The line that passes it to the picker is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`, which sets `locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}`.

Evidence, best first:

1. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`: passes the configured value to `LocationPicker`, clamped to at least 1.
2. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:19-42`: the picker accepts `locationsPerRequest` (default 50) and passes it to `useLocations`.
3. `openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md:5`: changeset for O3-6028 describing the fix and removal of the unused `numberToShow`.
4. Commit `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae`: the fix commit by Nethmi Rodrigo.
5. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts:44`: the `locationsPerRequest` config definition.
6. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker.test.tsx:435-457`: tests that the configured value reaches the picker and that zero falls back to 1.
7. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:68`: infinite-scroll trigger index derived from `locationsPerRequest`.

I did not open `config-schema.ts` or the test file, so their line references come from grep output only. The 50 default in the picker is in the styleguide component, and the login app's config mock also sets `locationsPerRequest: 50`.
